programme.desc: 'S4/E12 - Globetrottin' Trouble'. The chefs start off making their best coffee shop breakfast. Then, it's time to travel with a globetrotting dish and a dish with a fabulous filling.

programme.title: Guy's Grocery Games
programme.desc: 'S39/E2 - Beat The Judges: Noodles'. Guy Fieri welcomes three chefs whose noodle mastery helped them win in the past to take each other on in a non-stop noodle event.

programme.title: The Kitchen
programme.desc: 'S18/E9 - Perfect Plate Of Fall'. The gang serves up a plate of Fall favourites. The menu includes brown butter sage butternut squash bake and a crispy Asian brussels sprouts salad.

programme.desc: 'S45/E13 - Quail Without Fail'. Four chefs are challenged to make an entrée using quail, artichokes and anchovies. In the final basket, the chefs must cook with chicken salt and passion fruit.

programme.title: BBQ Brawl: Flay V. Chauhan V. Lofaso

programme.desc: 'S36/E11 - Gold Medal Games: Grand Finale'. The champions return for a shot at the $50,000 prize money. Their culinary skills are pushed to the limit, with very difficult challenges.

programme.desc: 'S49/E7 - Cooked With Care!'. Four nurses who love to cook show off their culinary skills! In the appetiser round, the competitors are handed canned bacon, mahi mahi fillets and kohlrabi.
